PANAWAGANG RALLY NI SINGSON

Former Ilocos Sur governor Luis “Chavit” Singson has called on the public—particularly religious groups and young people—to take part in a planned “one time, big time” rally against corruption.

Speaking at a press conference, Singson said the protest should be held as soon as possible and would culminate in a march to the presidential palace. “It should be ASAP and we will march to Malacañang,” he said.

While no specific date has been set, Singson said he is open to staging the rally in February, potentially coinciding with the anniversary of the EDSA People Power Revolution.

He also stressed the importance of youth leadership in organizing the demonstration, urging them to take an active role in deciding when it should take place. “I would prefer kabataan ang magsabi ng date... Tumayo kayo, huwag kayong matakot dahil future n'yo 'to.”

//Diumano
